title: Orange camera config image_levels block (version 1)
description: Camera config JSON (orange.camera.config v4) key image_levels: the whole-image brightness and saturation this camera should show in this configuration folder, checked at stream start (orange.recording.image_levels_check v1). At least one of expected_mean (with mean_tolerance_fraction) and max_saturated_fraction. basis records where the numbers came from: the GUI writes source gui_measurement, measured_at_utc, camera_frame_id, settings (as in the recording block) and statistics (orange.image_levels.v1). Unknown fields are refused at load. Parsed and written by src/image_levels.cpp.
